summary: Mitul Shah (Calculated Chaos, MICA visiting faculty) presented a brand-storytelling framework for TOC's independent-consultant and school-marketing audience, hosted by Devesh Lathi. The core teaching is the E.D.U.C.A.T.E. sequence (Examine, Decode, Unearth, Connect, Articulate, Trigger, Express) paired with 7 'emotional doors' (Joy, Surprise, Fear/Anxiety, Pride, Belonging, Nostalgia, Hope) that a story can open to earn audience attention. Shah argued that generic institutional claims ('world-class infrastructure,' '100% placements') fail because they carry no emotional signal, and walked through global ad case studies to show the Information -> Observation -> Emotion -> Communication flow in practice.
keyInsights: E.D.U.C.A.T.E. framework: Examine, Decode, Unearth, Connect, Articulate, Trigger, Express.
7 emotional doors a story can open: Joy, Surprise, Fear/Anxiety, Pride, Belonging, Nostalgia, Hope.
Generic marketing claims fail because they carry no emotional signal and are indistinguishable between competitors.
